name: Osbrin Selchoun
backstory: Osbrin Selchoun is the proprietor of Selchoun's Sundries Shop, a prosperous general store in Waterdeep. Originally located in the Sea Ward, his shop was destroyed in a mysterious fire in 1367 DR, leading him to reopen at a new location on Staghunter's Way near Heroes' Garden. He sells a variety of goods ranging from tourist trinkets and toys to mundane everyday necessities.
